narr: Moist south to southwest wind flow continued to provide the necessary ingredients for heavy showers and thunderstorms to form across SE Florida during the afternoon. Saturated grounds from previous rainfall contributed to the flash flooding.
ev: City of Hollywood emergency manager reported street flooding of up to 12 inches deep in several neighborhood streets. Media reports indicated water reaching a reporter's calves near Federal Highway and Roosevelt Street. ||Nearby rainfall measurements indicated amounts of up to 2 inches which fell in less than an hour.

Public and media reports of significant street and neighborhood flooding in Cutler Bay, mainly along Old Cutler Road from SW 216 Street to SW 224 Street, as well as in Silver Palms near SW 232 Street and SW 112 Avenue. Cars were reported to be stranded and water reaching the upper part of car tires.||Observed rainfall was as high as 4 inches in this area, most of which fell in less than 2 hours and aggravated pre-existing flooding in the area from recent heavy rainfall.
